blocks.text: Surrey Townhomes Under $1.2M — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: Which Surrey neighbourhoods have the most townhomes under $1.2M?
The highest concentration of strata townhomes under $1.2M is found in Fleetwood,
Guildford
, Newton/Panorama Ridge, Clayton and
Cloverdale
, and Grandview Heights / Morgan Heights in South Surrey.
What floorplans and sizes are typical for Surrey townhomes under $1.2M?

Most sub-$1.2M townhomes in Surrey are 3-storey wood-frame units between 1,250 and 1,850 sq ft with 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, or older 2-level townhouses in Guildford and Fleetwood offering wider living rooms and side-by-side garages.
How do tandem garages and side-by-side garages differ in Surrey townhomes?

Tandem garages park two cars one behind the other on the ground level and are standard in narrower 3-level townhouses built since 2005. Side-by-side double garages allow both vehicles to pull in and out independently and are usually found in end units, wider floorplans, or 2-storey complexes.
What are typical monthly strata fees for Surrey townhomes?

Strata fees for Surrey townhomes generally range from $250 to $475 per month depending on building age, roof/exterior reserve contributions, and whether the complex has a clubhouse, gym, or outdoor pool.
Can you rent out a townhome in Surrey?

Yes. Under BC Strata Property Act amendments, strata corporations cannot enforce general long-term rental bans on residential strata lots (except compliant 55+ age-restricted bylaws), though short-term vacation rentals are commonly prohibited by bylaw.
How will the Fleetwood and Clayton SkyTrain stations impact Surrey townhomes?

The Surrey-Langley SkyTrain extension along Fraser Highway puts direct rapid transit stations at 152 Street, 160 Street, and 166 Street in Fleetwood and 184 Street and 190 Street in Clayton/Cloverdale, connecting townhome corridors directly to Expo Line trains.
How do Surrey townhomes under $1.2M compare with detached houses under $1.8M?
Townhomes under $1.2M include strata-managed exterior upkeep and lower entry prices, whereas
Surrey detached homes under $1.8M
provide freehold land ownership, private driveways, and potential secondary suite income.
